import sys, importlib.util

# Load original parse from backup
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("parse_orig", "/tmp/parse_backup.py")
orig_parse = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(orig_parse)

r = orig_parse.parse('Pi/10 = {:8.5f}', 'Pi/10 = .31415')
print(f"Original result: {r}")

# Load modified parse
spec2 = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("parse_mod", "/tmp/parse_new_r9.py")
mod_parse = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec2)
spec2.loader.exec_module(mod_parse)

r2 = mod_parse.parse('Pi/10 = {:8.5f}', 'Pi/10 = .31415')
print(f"Modified result: {r2}")
PYEOF
